description: Summer karaoke night hosted by Roman Rybin (Bangladesh-Orchestra). Featuring hits from 90s and 2000s. Social gathering for Russian-speaking community.
original_text: KARAOKE PARTY NIGHT. Karaoke Summer Night. Для разгона вечеринки Роман поёт супер сет хитов 90-х, 2000-х. Стань звездой караоке.
